messages:
liam: Heads-up — planning a short continuous-batching throughput smoke today. Need ~15min window to compare max_batch_size=64 vs 128 and queue_window_ms=8 vs 16 on the p3 pools. Aim: quick pass to check throughput delta and p99 tail impact. Who can join?

carmen: I can run the loadgen and upload logs. Prefer after 16:00 PT. Will also capture KV cache hit stats.

vikram: quick ask — can you run with tracing on the batcher (env BATCHER_TRACE=1) so we can see queue hold times? also include --trace-kv for cache samples.

liam: yes please enable trace. Also let's pin model to r-infer/ggml-13b:v3 for reproducibility.

vikram: loadgen command I usually use:
```
./scripts/loadgen --model r-infer/ggml-13b:v3 --concurrency 12 --rps 1500 --payload "{\"input\":\"lorem ipsum\"}" --max-tokens 512 --duration 300 --outdir /tmp/cb-smoke \
```
Change rps/concurrency as needed for the pool.

carmen: thanks. I'll run two variants:
1) max_batch_size=64, queue_window_ms=8
2) max_batch_size=128, queue_window_ms=16
Both with BATCHER_TRACE=1 and KV_TRACE=1. Uploading traces to s3://redwood-logs/cb-smoke/{run-id}/

perf-bot: Benchmark queued: run_id=run-2045678910-1. Notifying infra for warmup.

infra-bot: GPU pool warmup complete. pool=staging-p3, nodes=6, expected throughput headroom=~2x.

liam: amazing. @carmen please post PR link if you need config changes; @vikram will watch traces. I'll be nearby for quick followups.

carmen: run #1 finished. Quick summary:
- variant: batch=64, window=8ms
- throughput: 1.85k tokens/sec (avg)
- p50/p95/p99 latency: 42ms / 160ms / 205ms
- KV cache hit: 23%
Logs: s3://redwood-logs/cb-smoke/run-2045678910-1/logs.tar.gz

carmen: run #2 finished. Quick summary: 
- variant: batch=128, window=16ms
- throughput: 2.12k tokens/sec (avg)
- p50/p95/p99 latency: 58ms / 200ms / 285ms
- KV cache hit: 21%
Logs: s3://redwood-logs/cb-smoke/run-2045678910-2/logs.tar.gz

sophia: thanks for the runs — looks like 128 ups throughput but increases tail latency a bit. We saw some long queue hold events in the traces at ~8:20 into the run (batcher hold ~120ms).

vikram: looking at traces — confirmed. Batching heuristic is packing full batches even when tokens per request are small which increases stall for straggling requests. Suggest tweak: prefer smaller batch sizes when avg_tokens_per_req < 32. Pseudocode: 
```
if avg_tokens_per_req < 32:
  max_batch_size = min(config.max_batch_size, 64)
else:
  max_batch_size = config.max_batch_size
```
This is cheap and should reduce tail.

liam: sounds reasonable. Can you open a tiny PR with the heuristic + unit test? Keep flag gated behind `runtime.flags.cb_dynamic_small_batching`.

vikram: will do. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4823

carmen: quick diffs on config and smoke results: after applying local patch (small-batch heuristic) I re-ran a short check (same loadgen) — got throughput ~2.0k and p99 220ms. Not as high throughput as 128, but p99 improved a lot. Uploading results: s3://redwood-logs/cb-smoke/run-2045678910-3/

liam: perfect. Plan: merge PR behind flag, canary to 10% traffic on staging first, run full 10min loadgen, then evaluate metrics. @sophia please prepare alert thresholds for p95/p99 regressions tied to this set.

sophia: will add alerts. p95 > 220ms or p99 > 300ms = page. p95 increase > 20% from baseline = warn.

carmen: added a quick smoke note in the PR and uploaded artifacts + perf graphs. Also added a small test in bench/ that simulates low-token requests.

vikram: review comments addressed. Added flag gating and unit test. Requesting review from @liam and @sophia.

liam: will review in ~30m. If green, schedule canary for 11:00 PT.

perf-bot: Canary scheduled: pr=4823, rollout=10%, start=2045683200.

infra-bot: Canary infra prepped. Please ensure rollback policy exists.

liam: rollback policy is in the PR: automatic revert if p95 > 220ms sustained for 5m.

carmen: thanks everyone — will monitor runs and post a short summary after canary completes. :rocket: :eyes:
